title: Introducing: New Microsoft Copilot Chat in Business Central
summary: This short video introduces the new Microsoft Copilot chat experience in Business Central, which replaces the old Copilot UI. It is the same Copilot experience used across other Microsoft products. It answers questions using Business Central data, respecting the user's permissions and context. With the additional Microsoft Copilot license it can also use Work IQ data such as calendar, email, Teams and files. A short demo asks about Copilot features, then about the most urgent sales orders, opens the data side by side and follows up with a question about an Adatum fulfillment backlog.

features.name: New Microsoft Copilot chat in Business Central
features.description: A unified Microsoft Copilot experience, shared across Microsoft products, now opened from the Copilot button in Business Central. It replaces the old Copilot UI and has access to Business Central data, the user's permissions and context.
caveats: The speaker says you have access to it in your newest Business Central, but does not say preview or GA.
The speaker calls this the first and simple example; more detail comes in the next video.

features.name: Work IQ data in Copilot
features.description: With the additional Microsoft Copilot license, Copilot data also comes from Work IQ: calendar, emails, Teams conversations and files on OneDrive or SharePoint, and more.

features.name: General and documentation-based answers
features.description: Copilot can answer questions about Business Central data, and also questions not fully related to Business Central. In the demo, a question about Copilot features is answered with data from documentation, the internet and Business Central context.

features.name: Business Central data search by Copilot
features.description: Copilot searches Business Central data using the user's context, permissions and company. The demo asks for the most urgent sales orders.

features.name: Side-by-side data view and follow-up conversation
features.description: The data Copilot finds can be opened side by side with the chat, and the user can keep the conversation going. The demo follows up with a question about the fulfillment backlog for Adatum Corporation.
